title: Deer holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M38 55 Q34 42 40 30' stroke='#b06a2c' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='22' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#e0483c'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='17' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ff8a7a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M40 34 L44 34 L42 38 Z' fill='#b8302a'/>
  <!-- deer body -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='70' rx='17' ry='16' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='47' y='80' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#a5693a'/>
  <rect x='64' y='80' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#a5693a'/>
  <!-- arms holding string -->
  <path d='M46 66 Q40 60 39 54' stroke='#c98a4b' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M70 66 Q74 62 76 58' stroke='#c98a4b' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='68' r='4' fill='#f0d8b8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='45' r='14' fill='#d99a58'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='34' rx='5.5' ry='8' fill='#a5693a' transform='rotate(-25 45 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='34' rx='5.5' ry='8' fill='#a5693a' transform='rotate(25 71 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='34' rx='2.6' ry='4.2' fill='#f0c8a0' transform='rotate(-25 45 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='34' rx='2.6' ry='4.2' fill='#f0c8a0' transform='rotate(25 71 34)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M50 32 Q48 24 44 20 M46 26 Q42 24 40 22' stroke='#e8c890' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M66 32 Q68 24 72 20 M70 26 Q74 24 76 22' stroke='#e8c890' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='52' rx='7.5' ry='5.5' fill='#f0c8a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='49.5' rx='2.6' ry='2' fill='#7a4a24'/>
  <path d='M55 54 Q58 56.5 61 54' stroke='#7a4a24' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='51' cy='42' r='2.6' fill='#4a2a12'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='42' r='2.6' fill='#4a2a12'/>
  <circle cx='51.8' cy='41.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff'/>
  <circle cx='65.8' cy='41.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff'/>
  <!-- cheek glow -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='2.4' fill='#ff9a80' opacity='0.65'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='2.4' fill='#ff9a80' opacity='0.65'/>
</svg>
